text:
Mira: quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A. we need a single readiness plan for API adaptive batching, Console per-route cost view, and Optimize suggestions UI so marketing/docs/legal can finalize comms. who signs off and what are the hard gates?
Oscar: owners: adaptive batching -> Ben/eng-runtime, console cost-view -> Lina/billing+console, Optimize suggestions -> Harpreet/optimize.
Lina: on per-route costs: we'll surface an "Estimated" badge and include a CSV export of raw tagged usage for reconciliation. finance wants at least one anonymized customer sample validated before public roll.
Ben: batching note: decoder scheduling and KV-cache touches. canary must validate p95 and cache-hit ratios on representative traffic. we'll add an SDK flag and a migration guide.
Mira: can we lock tentative canary dates? marketing needs embargo windows.
Ben: propose adaptive-batching canary 2024-07-12 for 72h, open beta ~2024-08-09.
Lina: console internal preview 2024-08-02, public roll 2024-08-23 (one-week embargo after internal preview).
Harpreet: Optimize suggestions UI canary 2024-07-20; initial canary shows suggestions + feedback widget only, no auto-apply. retention opt-in required for eval logs (30-45 days).
Mira: telemetry gating specifics?
Ben: gating: p95 regression <= 8% on sampled flows, error-rate spike <1.3x baseline, KV-miss delta <2%.
Lina: console gating: backend billing tags stable for 48h before preview; tooltip copy explaining "Estimated vs Export" must be ready.
Harpreet: UX gating: beta pill, feedback widget, opt-in in org settings, and collection of qualitative feedback during canary.
infra-bot: scheduled: canary-deploy/adaptive-batching on 2024-07-12 01:30 UTC. health checks: p95, error-rate, KV-eviction-rate. auto-rollback on error-rate >1.5x baseline.
Mira: docs requests: please attach a reproducible sample route.json and token-profile.csv so docs can build screenshots and runnable samples.
docs-bot: docs ticket DOCS-5001 created. please upload sample route + token-profile to the ticket.
Oscar: SDK flag name suggestion: `enable_adaptive_batching`. example snippet we'll publish: `client.updateConfig({enable_adaptive_batching:true,batching:{max_latency_ms:18,min_batch:4}})`. will include ordering caveat.
Lina: I'll draft tooltip copy and circulation notes for finance by 2024-07-01.
Ben: we'll publish sample route + node script by 2024-06-28.
Harpreet: will add feedback widget mockups to the canary ticket by 2024-06-26 and confirm retention opt-in UI.
Mira: action items summary: (1) Ben publish sample route + script by 2024-06-28, (2) Lina draft tooltip and coordinate finance sample by 2024-07-01, (3) Harpreet upload UX mocks + retention flow by 2024-06-26, (4) docs add screenshots from samples by 2024-07-05, (5) infra run pre-canary load sweep on 2024-07-10 and post results to eng-sre.
Oscar: one more: Dedicated customers with pinned models will have migration toggles; infra will surface a console opt-in and block auto-migration until org enables it.
Mira: perfect. I'll compile the post-all-hands summary and link back to this thread. ping me if dates slip. :thumbsup:
